text: Head calibrate: floor ChArUco board at 3-4 spots over a pan/tilt grid driven by the node, one fit of head height, mount roll/pitch, tilt zero and camera lever, applied as a head_chain override read by head_state_publisher, mcp_server HeadKinematics and front camera, and the web UI.

Arm calibrate: small ChArUco plate on the gripper seen by the head; arm moves start small (wrist/elbow), bigger joints only with the user's OK; fits shoulder_lift, elbow, wrist_flex, wrist_roll offsets and head yaw/x/y with the arm as yaw reference; output is a joint_offsets_rad snippet for review and commit, the head part applied.
Two buttons on the web UI Calibrate page: Head calibrate, then Arm calibrate.
Runs after the head mount reprint allowing >= 60 deg tilt-down; the existing 6x5 ChArUco board doubles as the gripper plate; the tilt range is widened once the reprint is mounted.
Synthetic-scene tests for both fits, READMEs and tests/README.md, and a runbook executed on the robot with real numbers.

Gate Q2: reuse the existing 6x5 ChArUco board (models/charuco-6x5-40mm, scripts/markers_generate.yaml charuco:, ids 0-14) as the gripper plate; no new plate is generated. Floor and gripper captures are separate sessions (head_chain, arm) with the one physical board, so ids never clash.
